name: American Civil Liberties Union
blurb: Legal organization defending civil liberties in the United States.

name: Anti-Defamation League
blurb: Tracks antisemitism and extremism, and publishes research on hate movements.

name: Amadeu Antonio Stiftung
blurb: German foundation that supports work against right-wing extremism, racism, and antisemitism.

name: apabiz
blurb: Berlin research archive on the far right, antisemitism, and right-wing violence.

name: Bellingcat
blurb: Open-source investigative collective. The method is published with the findings.

name: Belltower.News
blurb: Journalism on the far right, racism, and antisemitism, published with the Amadeu Antonio Stiftung.

name: Brennan Center for Justice
blurb: Law and policy institute focused on democracy, voting, and the rule of law.

name: CORRECTIV
blurb: German nonprofit newsroom. Investigative reporting, including on the far right.

name: Equal Justice Initiative
blurb: Legal and historical work on racial injustice, excessive punishment, and mass incarceration.

name: EU DisinfoLab
blurb: European nonprofit researching disinformation campaigns and coordinated influence operations.

name: FactCheck.org
blurb: Nonpartisan project of the Annenberg Public Policy Center. It checks claims by politicians and political groups.

name: HOPE not hate
blurb: The United Kingdom's leading campaign against the far right.

name: Human Rights Watch
blurb: Investigates and reports on human rights abuses worldwide.

name: Indivisible
blurb: Volunteer-led groups organizing locally in the United States.

name: Institute for Strategic Dialogue
blurb: Research institute that detects and exposes extremism, disinformation, and authoritarianism.

name: PolitiFact
blurb: Fact-checking desk that rates political claims. A project of the Poynter Institute.

name: ProPublica
blurb: Independent newsroom for investigative journalism in the public interest.

name: Protect Democracy
blurb: Nonpartisan nonprofit working against the decline of American democracy.

name: Southern Poverty Law Center
blurb: Tracks hate and extremist groups in the United States and publishes Hatewatch.
